# @ic-reactor/codegen

> The generation pipeline behind `@ic-reactor/cli` and
> `@ic-reactor/vite-plugin`: from a `.did` file it writes declarations, a typed
> reactor with bound React hooks, and optionally one query or mutation object
> per method.

Applies to `@ic-reactor/codegen` 0.15.1.

Read this file from `node_modules/@ic-reactor/codegen/llms.txt` when writing
code against the installed version. The complete guide for every package is
https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/llms-full.txt, and behaviour changes are in
https://github.com/B3Pay/ic-reactor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md.

## Install

Apps install `@ic-reactor/vite-plugin` (Vite) or `@ic-reactor/cli`
(anything else), which run this pipeline. Install it directly only for custom
tooling:

```bash
pnpm add -D @ic-reactor/codegen
```

## Setup and Usage

```ts
// scripts/generate.ts: custom tooling around the pipeline
import { runCanisterPipeline } from "@ic-reactor/codegen"

const result = await runCanisterPipeline({
  canisterConfig: {
    name: "backend",
    didFile: "./backend/backend.did",
    factories: true, // also write index.factories.generated.ts
    canisterId: "rrkah-fqaaa-aaaaa-aaaaq-cai", // for builds off a local replica
  },
  projectRoot: process.cwd(),
  globalConfig: {
    outDir: "src/declarations",
    clientManagerPath: "../../clients", // module exporting `clientManager`
    target: "react",
  },
})
if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error)
for (const warning of result.warnings ?? []) console.warn(warning)
```

The app then imports from the canister's entry:

```tsx
import {
  getMessageQuery,
  setMessageMutation,
  useBackendQuery,
} from "./declarations/backend"

export function Message() {
  const { data: message } = getMessageQuery.useQuery()
  const save = setMessageMutation.useMutation({
    invalidateQueries: [getMessageQuery],
  })
  const { data: greeting } = useBackendQuery({
    functionName: "greet",
    args: ["Ada"],
  })
  return (
    <button onClick={() => save.mutate(["hello"])}>
      {greeting}: {message}
    </button>
  )
}
// Outside React: await getMessageQuery.fetch(), await setMessageMutation.execute(["hello"])
```

## Generated Files

Per canister, under `<outDir>/<name>/`:

| File                           | Owner                     | Content                                                                                |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `declarations/`                | codegen, every run        | `idlFactory` (`.js`) and `_SERVICE` (`.d.ts`) named after the `.did`, and a copy of it |
| `index.generated.ts`           | codegen, every run        | `<name>Reactor` and six hooks: `use<Name>Query`, `use<Name>Mutation`, ...              |
| `index.factories.generated.ts` | codegen, with `factories` | `<method>Query` / `<method>Mutation` per method                                        |
| `index.ts`                     | you, after the first run  | re-exports the managed files; put your own code here                                   |

- The reactor is a `DisplayReactor` unless `mode` names `Reactor`,
  `CandidReactor`, `CandidDisplayReactor` or `MetadataDisplayReactor`.
- `target: "react"` (default) adds the hooks; `target: "core"` writes only the
  typed reactor, with no `@ic-reactor/react` import.
- `clientManagerPath` is the import path, relative to the generated file, of a
  module that exports `clientManager` (default `../../clients`).
- `generateReactor: false` writes only `declarations/`.

## Factories (`factories: true`)

| Method                                       | Factory              | Export             |
| -------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------ |
| `query` or `composite_query`, no arguments   | `createQuery`        | `<method>Query`    |
| `query` or `composite_query`, with arguments | `createQueryFactory` | `<method>Query`    |
| update (no annotation) or `oneway`           | `createMutation`     | `<method>Mutation` |

- An update method is never generated as a query.
- `<method>` is camelCase (`get_message` gives `getMessageQuery`). A name that
  would start with a digit gets a leading `_`; a name an earlier method (in
  Candid's order) or a hook already took gets `_` appended.
  `getFactoryExportNames(canisterName, methods)` returns the names.
- Each call is `/* @__PURE__ */`, so a bundler drops the factories an app does
  not import, even through `export *`.
- Needs `target: "react"`; with `target: "core"` the run fails with a
  `CodegenConfigError` before writing anything. Switching the option off
  removes the file.
- An `index.ts` you edited is not rewritten; until it contains
  `export * from "./index.factories.generated"`, the run returns a warning.
  An export of the same name in `index.ts` replaces the generated one.
- Like the reactor, the objects are module scope: fine in a client-only app,
  not for per-request use on a server.

## Validation and Failure Modes

- The config is validated before anything is written, and a violation throws
  `CodegenConfigError`. The checks are exported: `assertSafeCanisterConfig`,
  `assertSafeCanisterName`, `assertSafeModuleSpecifier`,
  `assertContainedPath`, `assertOneOf`, `resolveContainedOutDir`,
  `resolveDeclarationsBaseName`, with `CANISTER_NAME_PATTERN`,
  `REACTOR_CLASS_NAMES` and `CODEGEN_TARGETS`.
- `outDir` must resolve inside `projectRoot`, and names must match
  `CANISTER_NAME_PATTERN`.
- A `.did` that declares no service is rejected.
- Each `outDir` carries a `.ic-reactor-owner` marker, so a second canister
  cannot write into a directory another one owns. Two entries with the same
  `name` and `outDir` pass the marker;
  `findSharedOutDirs(entries, outDir, projectRoot)` finds them and
  `sharedOutDirMessage(...)` words the error.
- Without `canisterId`, the generated reactor reads its id from the `ic_env`
  cookie, which only a local replica (or `allowEnvConfig: true`) trusts, so
  importing it throws `canisterId is required` in Node, during SSR and on a
  deployed origin.

## Do Not

- Edit `index.generated.ts`, `index.factories.generated.ts` or
  `declarations/`; change the `.did` or the options and generate again.
- Hand-write `createQuery` / `createMutation` modules that only restate method
  names; set `factories: true` and customize in `index.ts`.
- Point two canisters at one output directory.
- Import the generated modules into a React Server Component: they import
  hooks.
- Leave `canisterId` out for a build served anywhere but a local replica.
